english: After his attempt, Campbell was disappointed to learn that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
text: 先前超过304英里是达到过的速度，这里299英里是平均速度，不能拿两者当自相矛盾。was disappointed to learn… 把情绪连到新得知的消息；表达听到结果后的反应，可用情绪词再接 to hear、to learn。
author: Codex
